title: Whispering Whelk Waltzer
statement: A pearly sea snail who believes every current is an invitation to dance, twirling slowly on a ribbon of mucus through a tank of lantern-lit teal water. Around it stand tilted slate pillars and curling kelp, and each time the snail completes a pirouette, a tiny chime of bubbles rises from its shell like a soft shush.
